title: Seller Performance Standing — Suspension, Appeal and Account Closure Terms by Level
content:
The appeal and closure terms of Seller Performance Standing are set per level. All but one are identical across the six levels; the time Northloop takes to decide an appeal is shorter at the two highest levels.

## Appeal decision time

| Level | Business days within which Northloop decides an appeal |
|---|---|
| Below Standard Level | 2 |
| Developing Seller Level | 2 |
| Standard Level | 2 |
| Above Standard Level | 2 |
| Top Rated Level | 1 |
| Preferred Partner Level | 1 |

## Terms identical at every level

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Appeal window — calendar days after the suspension date within which an appeal may be submitted | 30 |
| Appeals that may be submitted against one suspension | 3 |
| Violation types for which an appeal must be a plan of action | listing policy, restricted product, product authenticity, review manipulation |
| Accepting an appeal on the basis "violation issued in error" reverses the appealed violation's points | yes |
| Accepting a plan-of-action appeal keeps the violation points on record | yes |
| When a suspension becomes a deactivation | no appeal by the window end, or the appeal limit exhausted |
| Standing statuses in which the seller may close the selling account voluntarily | good standing, at risk |

## Points of reading

- The intellectual property and inauthentic complaint types are not on the plan-of-action list; the other four violation types are.
- The two acceptance settings work in opposite directions on points: an accepted "violation issued in error" appeal reverses the appealed violation's points, while an accepted plan-of-action appeal leaves them on record.
- A seller whose record is suspended, under appeal, deactivated or closed is not in a status listed for voluntary closure; only good standing and at risk are.
- Hypothetical example: an appeal from a seller placed at Top Rated Level is decided within 1 business day; an appeal from a seller placed at Standard Level is decided within 2.
